name: Brand
title: the Burning Vengeance

Q.name: Sear
Q.description: Brand launches a fireball that deals 70/100/130/160/190 + 0.65×AP magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the target is Ablaze, they will be Stunned for 1.75 seconds.
Q.summary: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.

W.name: Pillar of Flame
W.description: Brand creates a pillar of pure fire, dealing 75/120/165/210/255 + 0.7×AP magic damage. Units that are Ablaze take (75/120/165/210/255 + 0.7×AP) × 1.25 damage instead.
W.summary: After a short delay, Brand creates a Pillar of Flame at a target area, dealing magic damage to enemy units within the area. Units that are ablaze take an additional 25% damage.

E.name: Conflagration
E.description: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target, dealing 55/80/105/130/155 + 0.6×AP magic damage to surrounding units. If the target is Ablaze, the spread range is doubled.
E.summary: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target that spreads to nearby enemies, dealing magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Conflagration's spread is doubled.

R.name: Pyroclasm
R.description: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that can bounce to Brand or another enemy up to 5 times, dealing 100/175/250 + 0.3×AP magic damage to enemies each bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on champions. If the target is Ablaze, they are briefly Slowed by 30/45/60%.
R.summary: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that bounces up to 5 times off of Brand and nearby enemies, dealing magic damage to enemies each time bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on Champions. If a target is ablaze, Pyroclasm will briefly slow them.

Passive.name: Blaze
Passive.description: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. If Brand kills an enemy while it is ablaze he regains mana. When Blaze reaches max stacks on a Champion or large monster, it becomes unstable. It detonates in 2 seconds, applying spell effects and dealing massive damage in an area around the victim.
Passive.summary: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. If Brand kills an enemy while it is ablaze he regains mana. When Blaze reaches max stacks on a Champion or large monster, it becomes unstable. It detonates in 2 seconds, applying spell effects and dealing massive damage in an area around the victim.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Burn mage whose spells set targets ablaze and stack Blaze up to 3 times. Wins fights by landing Q stun on an ablaze target and detonating max-stack Blaze across a group with R bounces.
strengths: Q fireball stuns for 1.75 s if the target is ablaze
W pillar deals 25% more to ablaze targets
E is targeted, sets ablaze and spreads farther on ablaze targets
R bounces up to 5 times and slows ablaze targets
Passive at 3 stacks detonates for big area damage
weaknesses: No dash or self-peel beyond the Q stun
Q and W are skillshots; misses cut his damage
Squishy; weak to hard engage and assassins
R bounces back to him if there are no other enemies
profile.curveNote: E (targeted) then Q stun is his reliable combo; W adds damage at 3.

Passive.notes: Blaze: burn stacks to 3; at max it detonates in 2 s.

Q.notes: Fireball; 1.75 s stun if target is ablaze. Blockable.

W.notes: Delayed pillar; 25% more on ablaze targets.

E.notes: Targeted blast; spreads to nearby, double range on ablaze.

R.notes: Bounces up to 5 times; slows ablaze targets.

profile.windowAgainst: E or Q on cooldown: no stun setup, engage him.
checks: Whether R bounces are blockable by Yasuo W / Samira W.
